newsitem.title: UK: London Stock Exchange said probing insider ring.
newsitem.headline: London Stock Exchange said probing insider ring.

text.p: A ring of alleged insider dealers is being investigated at the London Stock Exchange, sources close to the bourse said on Monday.
"My understanding is that there is certainly one ring and that is under investigation," the source said.
On Monday, the Times newspaper reported that at least two major insider dealing rings were believed to be using the London Stock Exchange.
The report said insider dealing prosecutions had dwindled and criticised the need to prove beyond all reasonable doubt that an offence was committed.
A spokesman for the London Stock Exchange said he had no comment to make on the report.
